roadmap.title: 12-Week Roadmap
roadmap.desc: A system guiding you from getting familiar with tools, tracking progress, personalizing to your needs, to running autonomously without reminders. 12 weeks building an active lifestyle.

checklist.title: Daily & Weekly Checklist
checklist.badge: 6 daily items · 6 weekly targets · Weekend review
checklist.desc: A minimal checklist to maintain the 6 most important daily behaviors. Each tick is a small step building lasting habits.
checklist.img_caption: 6 behaviors · every day · under 5 minutes to tick

workout_log.title: Workout Log
workout_log.desc: Log your exercises, sets/reps, weight, and rate of perceived exertion (RPE). Review to know how to progress next week.

meal_plan.title: Meal Plan Template
meal_plan.badge: Standard plate · Nutrition diary · Vietnamese meal ideas
meal_plan.desc: A healthy plate model with ½ vegetables – ¼ protein – ¼ carbs. Keep a simple daily food diary to build nutritional awareness.
meal_plan.img_caption: ½ veg · ¼ protein · ¼ carbs · simple every meal

lifestyle_tracker.title: Lifestyle Tracker
lifestyle_tracker.desc: Track sleep, step count, and energy level every day. After 1 week you'll see clear patterns affecting how you feel.
lifestyle_tracker.img_caption: better sleep → better energy → better results

mind_tracker.title: Mind & Calm Tracker
mind_tracker.desc: Track stress, mood, and calm practices daily. Recognize signs of overload before burnout — no need to wait until you break down.

health_score.title: Daily Health Score
health_score.desc: Score your overall health daily across 7 behavior groups. Not to judge — but to know whether this week is heading in the right direction.
health_score.img_caption: measure to improve · not to blame yourself

meal_prep.title: 3-Day Meal Prep
meal_prep.desc: Cook once for 2–3 days. Consistent plate structure with flexible flavor variations. A practical solution for busy people who still want to eat healthy.
meal_prep.img_caption: cook once · 3 days without worrying what to eat

reset_protocol.title: Reset Protocol
reset_protocol.badge: After falling off · Get back right · No self-blame
reset_protocol.desc: Everyone falls off. What matters is how you get back. This is a concrete system for each situation — no judgment, just the next action.
reset_protocol.img_caption: falling off is normal · getting back is what matters

progress_test.title: 4-Week Progress Test
progress_test.badge: 8 metrics · Every 4 weeks · More than just weight
progress_test.desc: Measure progress beyond weight. 8 metrics reflect a fuller picture: fitness, recovery, mind, and lifestyle. Be balanced and honest with yourself.
progress_test.img_caption: holistic measurement · not just body weight

quick_workouts.title: Quick Workout Library
quick_workouts.desc: Workouts from 5–30 minutes for every situation. Too busy, too tired, or just need a reset — there's always a suitable option. No excuse is good enough to skip entirely.
quick_workouts.img_caption: there's always 5 minutes — there's always a choice
